name: leather leggings
_design_note: F1-30 light legs slot. Boiled leather thigh-to-knee. Leggings_of_Enkidu uses this as template_basis. Scouts and skirmishers wear these over heavier alternatives.
lore_template: Boiled {material_name} leggings shaped over a form, articulated thigh-to-knee in a single piece that bends with the wearer's stride. Scouts favor these over heavier alternatives — the legs protected without the weight that turns a sprint into a jog and a long-march evening into a limp.
